## Change

## Validation

Describe checks/comparisons, including source versions and periods for statistical changes.

- [ ] Structural repository checks pass.
- [ ] Methodology and data documentation reflect the change.
- [ ] New files contain no credentials, raw records, or internal drafts.
- [ ] Changed outputs were compared with the prior release.

## Release impact

State whether a data refresh, metadata change, or separate warehouse upload is needed.
